walkthroughs.body_html:
Density = mass / volume.

Solids and liquids are dense; gases are not.

Method: measure mass, find volume by displacement or ruler.

Q = m c delta T.

Water has c = 4200 J/kg/C.

Heating 1 kg water by 10 C needs 42000 J.

Energy to melt or vaporise per kg.

L of fusion of ice = 334 kJ/kg.

L of vaporisation of water = 2260 kJ/kg.
